intent: Deliver durable anomaly/outbox fanout and an in-app family inbox with live authorization, finite retry, deduplication and read state. Preserve event acknowledgement/closure metadata and medication records; support the authorized family lifecycle and safe asynchronous UI navigation.

findings.suggested_fix: Track pending collaboration POST promises in a shared module. Before inbox, family-event, detail or unread-count GETs, await outstanding writes and then recheck visibility/generation; preserve body clearing and live authorization.
findings.title: Re-entering during a pending action can leave stale inbox state
findings.why_it_matters: After tapping 全部已读, a user can return to 我的 and reopen the inbox before the POST finishes. The new list request may read the old unread state; when the POST later succeeds, its callback is discarded by the generation check, so the inbox keeps showing unread messages and count until another refresh. The same sequence after acknowledging or closing a family event can leave its old action button visible. Keep mutation completion separate from render cancellation and refresh the current page when an older mutation settles.

findings.title: Cover closure before family alert publication
findings.why_it_matters: If a family member acknowledges and closes an event while its alert is still pending, the later dispatch must cancel the alert. The new CLOSED branch implements that behavior, but the integration tests only cancel pending alerts after revocation and only close events after separate publication. A regression here could publish a stale alert for an already finished collaboration.

requirements.requirement: Transactional anomaly and owner/eligible-family outbox with per-event receiver deduplication
ACTIVE plus ABNORMAL_EVENT authorization, occurrence-time queue eligibility and permanent revocation of old family messages
In-app SENT publication, bounded batch/retries and continuation after one-message failure
Receiver/live-authorization SQL for list/count/detail/read/read-all and cursor limit 1..50
Acknowledgement then closure preserve first metadata and do not change medication records
Inbox entry/badge, filters/cursor/detail gating and family actions/history
requirements.note: Finding #2 identifies stale state after pending mutations across page instances.

testing_gaps: Real-MySQL fixtures cover sequential revocation/rebinding but not independent-transaction fanout versus unbind/rebind or simultaneous queue deduplication. No failing lock interleaving was established.
Mock dispatcher tests and single-transaction integration fixtures do not verify an actual publication rollback followed by failure bookkeeping in a separate committed transaction.

verdicts.reason: The frontend lifecycle script exercises a successful detail GET followed by a 403 read POST and asserts that the message body remains absent while the error appears.
Reopening either @Entry page creates a new instance that can load stale data before the earlier instance’s POST completes, and the earlier callback is discarded without refreshing the new instance.

The delivery service cancels a pending family message when its event is CLOSED, but the integration tests publish only before closure or after revocation and never exercise closure before publication.
